plugin.name: UI_Theme_Controller
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT UI THEME CONTROLLER v2.8
Public themes: theme default - GREEN TERMINAL palette (the old "green") theme classic - ORIGINAL gray/gold palette (the old "default") theme amber - amber terminal palette
There is no separate public "green" theme anymore: its palette IS "default". The former "default" palette has been moved to "classic". theme status
HP alert-theme commands: alert warning <percent> - yellow warning theme at/below this HP percentage alert alert <percent> - red alert theme at/below this HP percentage alert off - disable automatic HP warning/alert themes alert on - re-enable automatic HP warning/alert themes alert status - show thresholds, state, HP, and effective theme
For compatibility, "alert critical <percent>" and "alert red <percent>" are synonyms for "alert alert <percent>".
Defaults are warning 40% and alert 20%. Setting either threshold to 0 disables that individual tier.
For backward compatibility, "theme green" is accepted as a deprecated synonym for "theme default".
On first upgrade with the same plugin ID, saved names are migrated: old green -> default old default -> classic

function NormalizeThemeName(name) name = tostring(name or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if name == "green" then return "default" end if VALID_THEMES[name] then return name end return nil end
function MigrateSavedThemeName() -- v2.2 is the corrective rename pass: -- old green -> new default -- old default -> new classic -- -- If v2.1 was installed incompletely (for example themed clients were -- updated but the old controller remained), force the intended GREEN -- palette as the current default once so the suite cannot remain stuck on -- the old gray/gold palette while reporting "default". if GetVariable("theme_name_correction_v22") ~= "1" then SetVariable("theme", "default") SetVariable("effective_theme", "default") SetVariable("theme_name_migration_v21", "1") SetVariable("theme_name_correction_v22", "1") return "default" end
local existing = NormalizeThemeName(GetVariable("theme")) if not existing then existing = "default" end SetVariable("theme", existing)
-- A fresh plugin load should start from the user's base theme until a fresh -- HP observation arrives. Do not revive a stale red/warning state from disk. SetVariable("effective_theme", existing) return existing end
function CurrentTheme() local theme = NormalizeThemeName(GetVariable("theme")) if not theme then theme = "default" end return theme end
local function RefreshHPFromGauge() -- Calibrated HP parsing lives in HP_MP_Gauges. Treat its normalized -- percentage as the authoritative alert-theme source whenever available, -- rather than depending on the legacy fixed-format condition-line trigger. if PluginSupports( HP_GAUGE_PLUGIN_ID, "GetCurrentHPPercent" ) ~= error_code.eOK then return false end
local rc, value = CallPlugin( HP_GAUGE_PLUGIN_ID, "GetCurrentHPPercent" )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then return false end
local hp = tonumber(value) if not hp then return false end
lastHPPercent = ClampPercent(hp) return true end
local function EffectiveThemeForHP(hp) local base = CurrentTheme()
if not alertThemesEnabled then return base end
hp = tonumber(hp)
if not hp then return base end
-- Alert is more severe and therefore always wins when both ranges overlap. if criticalThreshold > 0 and hp <= criticalThreshold then return "red" end
if warningThreshold > 0 and hp <= warningThreshold then return "warning" end
return base end
local function BroadcastEffectiveTheme(force) -- Pull the most recent normalized HP from the calibrated gauge plugin when -- possible. The normal gauge broadcast still updates us immediately, but -- this closes reload/reinstall/order gaps and makes alert commands reliable. RefreshHPFromGauge()
local effective = EffectiveThemeForHP(lastHPPercent) local previous = tostring(GetVariable("effective_theme") or "")
SetVariable("theme", CurrentTheme()) SetVariable("effective_theme", effective)
-- Repaint when the effective theme changes, and also whenever explicitly -- forced by an alert/theme command or plugin lifecycle refresh. if force == true or previous ~= effective then BroadcastPlugin(THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE, effective) end
return effective end
function BroadcastTheme() return BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true) end
function SetTheme(name) local requested = tostring(name or ""):lower() local theme = NormalizeThemeName(requested) if not theme then return false end
SetVariable("theme", theme) SetVariable("theme_name_migration_v21", "1") BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true)
if requested == "green" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Theme] 'green' is now named 'default'.") end ColourNote("lime", "", "[Theme] " .. theme) return true end
local function CurrentEffectiveTheme() local effective = tostring(GetVariable("effective_theme") or ""):lower()
if effective == "warning" or effective == "red" then return effective end
return CurrentTheme() end
function GetThemeColour(profile, role) profile = tostring(profile or ""):lower() role = tostring(role or "")
local p = PALETTES[profile] if not p then return "" end
local effective = CurrentEffectiveTheme()
if effective == "warning" or effective == "red" then local alertPalette = ALERT_ROLE_COLOURS[effective] local alertColour = alertPalette and alertPalette[role] if alertColour and alertColour ~= "" then return tostring(alertColour) end end
local t = p[CurrentTheme()] if not t then return "" end return tostring(t[role] or "") end
function GetThemeName() return CurrentTheme() end
function GetEffectiveThemeName() return CurrentEffectiveTheme() end
local function ValidateAlertThresholds(newWarning, newCritical) newWarning = ClampPercent(newWarning) newCritical = ClampPercent(newCritical)
if newWarning > 0 and newCritical > 0 and newCritical > newWarning then return nil, nil, "Critical threshold cannot be higher than warning threshold." end
return newWarning, newCritical, nil end
local function SaveAlertThresholds() SetVariable("alert_warning_threshold", tostring(warningThreshold)) SetVariable("alert_critical_threshold", tostring(criticalThreshold)) SetVariable("alert_themes_enabled", alertThemesEnabled and "true" or "false") end
local function PersistAlertSettings() SaveAlertThresholds()
-- Commit the plugin variables immediately so alert on/off and thresholds -- survive disconnects, crashes, and client restarts without requiring a -- manual world save. Do not call this from OnPluginSaveState itself. pcall(SaveState) end
function AlertWarningCommand(name, line, wildcards) local requested = tonumber((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or "") if requested == nil or requested < 0 or requested > 100 then ColourNote("red", "", "[Alert] Warning threshold must be 0-100.") return end
local newWarning, newCritical, why = ValidateAlertThresholds(requested, criticalThreshold)
if why then ColourNote("red", "", "[Alert] " .. why) return end
warningThreshold = newWarning criticalThreshold = newCritical PersistAlertSettings() local effective = BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true)
ColourNote( "yellow", "", warningThreshold == 0 and "[Alert] Warning theme disabled." or "[Alert] Warning theme engages at/below " .. tostring(warningThreshold) .. "% HP." ) ColourNote("gray", "", "[Alert] Effective theme: " .. effective) end
function AlertCriticalCommand(name, line, wildcards) local requested = tonumber((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or "") if requested == nil or requested < 0 or requested > 100 then ColourNote("red", "", "[Alert] Alert threshold must be 0-100.") return end
local newWarning, newCritical, why = ValidateAlertThresholds(warningThreshold, requested)
if why then ColourNote("red", "", "[Alert] " .. why) return end
warningThreshold = newWarning criticalThreshold = newCritical PersistAlertSettings() local effective = BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true)
ColourNote( "yellow", "", criticalThreshold == 0 and "[Alert] Red alert theme disabled." or "[Alert] Red alert theme engages at/below " .. tostring(criticalThreshold) .. "% HP." ) ColourNote("gray", "", "[Alert] Effective theme: " .. effective) end
function AlertOffCommand(name, line, wildcards) alertThemesEnabled = false PersistAlertSettings() local effective = BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true)
ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Alert] Automatic HP warning/alert themes OFF.") ColourNote("gray", "", "[Alert] Restored base theme: " .. effective) end
function AlertOnCommand(name, line, wildcards) alertThemesEnabled = true PersistAlertSettings() local effective = BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true)
ColourNote("lime", "", "[Alert] Automatic HP warning/alert themes ON.") ColourNote("gray", "", "[Alert] Effective theme: " .. effective) end
function AlertStatusCommand(name, line, wildcards) RefreshHPFromGauge() local hpText = lastHPPercent and (tostring(lastHPPercent) .. "%") or "no fresh reading" ColourNote( "cyan", "", "[Alert] " .. (alertThemesEnabled and "ON" or "OFF") .. " warning=" .. tostring(warningThreshold) .. "% alert=" .. tostring(criticalThreshold) .. "% HP=" .. hpText .. " base=" .. CurrentTheme() .. " effective=" .. tostring(GetVariable("effective_theme") or CurrentTheme()) ) end
local function ObserveHPPercent(value) local hp = tonumber(value) if not hp then return false end
lastHPPercent = ClampPercent(hp)
-- Normally this only broadcasts when the effective theme changes. The -- controller can always recover missed repaint events through forced -- lifecycle/command refreshes and direct gauge queries. BroadcastEffectiveTheme(false) return true end
function SetObservedHPPercent(value) -- Public normalized-HP API for HP_MP_Gauges. This direct call is the -- primary cross-plugin path; the 9045 broadcast remains a compatibility -- fallback for older gauge versions and other consumers. if ObserveHPPercent(value) then return "ok" end
return "invalid" end
function ThemeConditionLine(name, line, wildcards) -- The alert theme has its own non-owning observer so it still works if the -- gauge window is hidden/disabled or another plugin changes its internals. -- We only need the HP field, so do not overfit the rest of the condition line. local hp = tostring(line or ""):match( "^%s*<<OVERALL CONDITION:%s*<HP:%s*(%d+)%%%s*>" )
ObserveHPPercent(hp) end
function ThemeCommand(name, line, wildcards) local arg = tostring((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):lower() if arg == "" or arg == "status" then ColourNote( "cyan", "", "[Theme] base=" .. CurrentTheme() .. " effective=" .. tostring(GetVariable("effective_theme") or CurrentTheme()) .. " available: default, classic, amber" ) return end if not SetTheme(arg) then ColourNote("red", "", "[Theme] Unknown theme. Use default, classic, or amber.") end end
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if msg ~= HP_PERCENT_BROADCAST_MESSAGE or id ~= HP_GAUGE_PLUGIN_ID then return end
-- Gauge broadcast is retained as a fallback/secondary source. The direct -- condition observer above normally sees the same HP first; de-duplication in -- BroadcastEffectiveTheme prevents a second redraw. ObserveHPPercent(text) end
function OnPluginInstall() warningThreshold = ClampPercent( tonumber(GetVariable("alert_warning_threshold")) or DEFAULT_WARNING_THRESHOLD ) criticalThreshold = ClampPercent( tonumber(GetVariable("alert_critical_threshold")) or DEFAULT_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD ) alertThemesEnabled = GetVariable("alert_themes_enabled") ~= "false"
local w, c, why = ValidateAlertThresholds(warningThreshold, criticalThreshold) if why then warningThreshold = DEFAULT_WARNING_THRESHOLD criticalThreshold = DEFAULT_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD else warningThreshold = w criticalThreshold = c end
SaveAlertThresholds() MigrateSavedThemeName() RefreshHPFromGauge() BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true) end
function OnPluginEnable() MigrateSavedThemeName() RefreshHPFromGauge() BroadcastEffectiveTheme(true) end
function OnPluginSaveState() local theme = CurrentTheme() SetVariable("theme", theme) SaveAlertThresholds() SetVariable("effective_theme", EffectiveThemeForHP(lastHPPercent)) end
